title: El que mira donde nadie mira
subtitle: Volumen 1

hero.name: Kia
hero.outfit: an oversized grey hoodie over a black t-shirt, dark jeans and worn trainers
hero.trait: no se rinde y se fija en lo que nadie mira

vigia.label: VIGÍA
vigia.sheet: an adult male superhero in his thirties, tall and heavily built, wearing dark navy blue armour with crimson red plates on the shoulders and chest, a cracked grey visor covering the eyes, a torn short cape, short blond stubble beard visible below the visor

nul.label: NUL
nul.sheet: a tall faceless villain in a long black coat, his body made of shifting fragments of black code, wearing a completely smooth blank white mask with no features, black gloves

cover.scene: dramatic comic book cover composition: the teenage boy standing small in the foreground on a rooftop at night with an open glowing laptop under his arm, looking up; behind and above him the enormous silhouette of an armoured superhero against a burning orange sky, and further back the faint outline of a faceless masked figure made of black code; the city far below

panels.scene: a teenage boy's small bedroom at night lit only by three computer monitors, a window behind showing a city skyline, posters on the wall, he sits hunched at the desk with his back to us

bubbles.text: Un bug más y me voy a dormir.

panels.scene: extreme close-up of his face lit from below by the monitor glow, frowning, eyes narrowed at something on the screen
close-up of a computer monitor filling the frame, endless lines of glitching red code cascading and disappearing, a warning glow, no people in the shot

bubbles.text: Alguien estaba borrando la ciudad. Línea a línea.

panels.scene: the boy leaning back slowly in his chair, hands frozen over the keyboard, staring at the screens
wide night view of a huge city skyline seen from above, entire districts blacking out one after another in a spreading wave of darkness, no people in the shot
the boy standing at his dark bedroom window, silhouetted, the dead city below, only his laptop still glowing behind him
street level: cars stopped in the middle of a dark avenue, dead traffic lights, people getting out of their cars and looking up, no main character in the shot
dramatic wide shot: an armoured figure crashes down onto the flat rooftop of the building opposite, sparks and dust exploding outward, the dark dead city behind, seen from a distance
the armoured superhero standing battered on the rooftop among smoke, one arm hanging, looking straight at the viewer through a cracked visor

bubbles.text: ¿Eres tú el que ha visto el patrón?

panels.scene: the boy frozen at his open window, laptop still in one hand, looking up at something enormous outside, tiny in the frame

bubbles.text: Yo... yo solo miraba los registros.

panels.scene: the armoured superhero crouching down to be at eye level with someone shorter, holding out a scorched metal shard in his glove

bubbles.text: Llevo tres noches persiguiendo a algo que no deja huella.

panels.scene: close-up of the boy holding the scorched shard, turning it over, examining it with sudden concentration

bubbles.text: Sí que la deja. Deja el hueco donde estaba.

panels.scene: the armoured hero straightening up sharply, surprised, the cracked visor catching the light
the boy already sitting down cross-legged on the rooftop gravel, opening his laptop, hood up, wind in his hair

bubbles.text: Dame una hora y un sitio con luz.

panels.scene: the boy typing fast on the laptop on his knees on the windy rooftop, the armoured hero standing behind him with arms folded, the dead city below

bubbles.text: No busco lo que hizo. Busco lo que no está.

panels.scene: close-up of a laptop screen filling the frame, a glowing wireframe map of the city with hundreds of grey dots and one single red dot pulsing on a northern tower, no people in the shot
the armoured superhero already launching himself off the edge of the roof, cape snapping, motion lines, seen from behind
the boy alone on the empty rooftop, half standing, arm still raised where the hero was a second ago
wide shot of a tall dark corporate tower at night, a distant orange explosion blooming on one of the upper floors, no people visible

bubbles.text: Llegó a la planta 44 en cuarenta segundos.

panels.scene: close-up of a laptop screen filling the frame, the glowing city map dissolving into static and glitch fragments, the red dot gone, no people in the shot

bubbles.text: No había nadie. Nunca lo hubo.

panels.scene: the boy sitting very still on the rooftop, the laptop dark on his knees, shoulders dropped, dawn starting behind him

bubbles.text: Le he mandado a un sitio vacío.

panels.scene: vertical composition: the armoured superhero landing hard back on the rooftop, armour smoking and scorched, one shoulder plate torn off, looming tall

bubbles.text: Era una trampa. Y tú me metiste dentro.

panels.scene: close-up of the boy's face looking down and away, jaw tight, refusing to cry
the armoured hero walking away toward the far edge of the roof, seen from behind, dawn light ahead of him
the boy sitting alone with his back against a rooftop wall at first light, closed laptop on his knees, the sky going from black to orange above him
the boy opening the laptop again in the dawn light, face lit blue, starting to read from the very beginning

bubbles.text: Volvió a mirar. Otra vez. Y otra.

panels.scene: extreme close-up of his eyes reflecting scrolling lines of code, pupils widening as he realises something

bubbles.text: Nadie borra tan limpio... salvo el que tiene prisa.

panels.scene: close-up of a laptop screen filling the frame, thousands of code lines in grey with one single line highlighted in bright red, no people in the shot
wide shot: the boy running full speed across a rooftop at sunrise with the open laptop clutched to his chest, jumping a low wall

bubbles.text: Seis manzanas. Con el portátil abierto.

panels.scene: the armoured superhero sitting slumped against a water tank, helmet off his knee, repairing a broken shoulder plate with his bare hands
the boy standing in front of him out of breath, holding the glowing laptop screen up like a shield, absolutely certain

bubbles.text: Y yo te dije que deja huella. Mira.

panels.scene: wide establishing shot of a vast dark server hall, towers of blinking machines in long rows, thick cables hanging like vines from the ceiling, no people in the shot

bubbles.text: Planta menos tres. La que no sale en los planos.

panels.scene: the boy walking between two rows of server racks with the laptop open in his arms, small against the machines, blue light on his face

bubbles.text: Está aquí abajo. Lo noto en la latencia.

panels.scene: the armoured superhero moving ahead down the aisle with one fist raised, ready, armour scorched, seen from behind

bubbles.text: Detrás de mí. Esta vez de verdad.

panels.scene: close-up of a bank of server lights all turning from green to red at once, row after row, no people in the shot
dramatic wide shot: the faceless villain in a long black coat standing at the far end of the server hall under a single hanging light, body made of shifting black code fragments, towering and still
close-up of the smooth blank white mask filling the frame, fragments of black code peeling off its edge

bubbles.text: Yo borré a tu ciudad entera antes de cenar.

panels.scene: the boy standing his ground, small, jaw set, laptop held tight against his chest
violent action: the armoured superhero charging forward down the aisle, fist first, motion lines, debris flying
a huge blast of black code fragments erupting outward through a row of server racks, metal tearing, sparks, no faces visible
the armoured superhero lying face down and sparking on the floor among broken machines, one arm outstretched, visor cracked open
the boy alone on his knees beside the fallen hero, terrified, the huge shadow of the villain falling over them both
wide dramatic shot: the boy kneeling on the floor of the dark server hall, laptop open, typing with total concentration, blue screen light on his face, the enormous villain looming above him

bubbles.text: No tenía poderes. Tenía la costumbre de no rendirse.

panels.scene: close-up of the laptop screen filling the frame, the same highlighted red line of code now repeated a thousand times and multiplying, no people in the shot
the faceless villain coming apart, his body of black code fragments unravelling upward into nothing, the blank white mask cracking down the middle
the boy still kneeling, lit from below by the laptop, looking up at the empty air where the villain was, exhausted
wide shot of the whole city skyline at dawn with the lights coming back on district by district in a spreading wave, no people in the shot
the boy and the battered armoured superhero sitting side by side on the edge of the rooftop, feet hanging over the drop, the lit city below them
close-up of the boy in profile against the sunrise, half a smile, hood down, hair moving in the wind
